LRU cache with TTL for merged search results (plan §13.10).\n//!\n//! Caches completed scatter-gather results to reduce redundant fan-out under\n//! bursty repeat-query traffic (pagination, retries, facet-count polling).\n//!\n//! # Cache Key\n//!\n//! - `index_name`: Target index UID\n//! - `canonicalized_query_body`: Query JSON sorted deterministically\n//! - `settings_version`: Index settings version (invalidates on schema change)\n//!\n//! # Cache Value\n//!\n//! - Serialized `MergedSearchResult` as JSON bytes\n//!\n//! # Expiration\n//!\n//! - TTL-based expiration (configurable via `ttl_ms`, default 500ms)\n//! - LRU eviction when `max_size` is exceeded (default 1000 entries)\n\nuse crate::config::ResultCacheConfig;\nuse crate::Result;\nuse std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher;\nuse std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tracing::{debug, trace};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Cache entry with timestamp for TTL\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Single cache entry with expiration timestamp.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct CacheEntry {\n    /// Cached JSON bytes (serialized MergedSearchResult).\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n    /// Expiration timestamp.\n    expires_at: Instant,\n}\n\nimpl CacheEntry {\n    /// Create a new cache entry with TTL.\n    fn new(data: Vec<u8>, ttl: Duration) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            data,\n            expires_at: Instant::now() + ttl,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this entry has expired.\n    fn is_expired(&self) -> bool {\n        Instant::now() >= self.expires_at\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Cache key structure\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Cache key combining index, query, and settings version.\n///\n/// Uses hash-based equality for efficient comparison while maintaining\n/// deterministic key generation for identical queries.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub struct CacheKey {\n    /// Hash of the canonicalized components.\n    hash: u64,\n}\n\nimpl CacheKey {\n    /// Create a new cache key from the components.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `index_name` - Target index UID\n    /// * `canonicalized_query_body` - Query JSON sorted deterministically\n    /// * `settings_version` - Index settings version (invalidates on schema change)\n    pub fn new(index_name: &str, canonicalized_query_body: &str, settings_version: u64) -> Self {\n        let mut hasher = DefaultHasher::new();\n        index_name.hash(&mut hasher);\n        canonicalized_query_body.hash(&mut hasher);\n        settings_version.hash(&mut hasher);\n        Self {\n            hash: hasher.finish(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a cache key for testing or special cases.\n    pub fn from_hash(hash: u64) -> Self {\n        Self { hash }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Result cache implementation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// LRU cache with TTL for merged search results.\npub struct ResultCache {\n    /// LRU cache backing store.\n    cache: Arc<RwLock<lru::LruCache<CacheKey, CacheEntry>>>,\n    /// Cache configuration.\n    config: ResultCacheConfig,\n    /// Cache hit count (for metrics).\n    hits: Arc<RwLock<u64>>,\n    /// Cache miss count (for metrics).\n    misses: Arc<RwLock<u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl ResultCache {\n    /// Create a new result cache with the given configuration.\n    pub fn new(config: ResultCacheConfig) -> Self {\n        use std::num::NonZeroUsize;\n        let capacity = NonZeroUsize::new(config.max_size).unwrap_or_else(|| NonZeroUsize::new(1).unwrap());\n        let cache = lru::LruCache::new(capacity);\n        Self {\n            cache: Arc::new(RwLock::new(cache)),\n            config,\n            hits: Arc::new(RwLock::new(0)),\n            misses: Arc::new(RwLock::new(0)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get a cached result if available and not expired.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(Some(data))` on cache hit, `Ok(None)` on miss,\n    /// or `Err` if the cache is disabled.\n    pub async fn get(&self, key: &CacheKey) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n\n        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;\n\n        if let Some(entry) = cache.get(key) {\n            if entry.is_expired() {\n                // Entry expired - remove it and return miss\n                cache.pop(key);\n                *self.misses.write().await += 1;\n                trace!(\"Cache expired for key {:?}\", key);\n                return Ok(None);\n            }\n\n            // Cache hit\n            *self.hits.write().await += 1;\n            debug!(\"Cache hit for key {:?}\", key);\n            Ok(Some(entry.data.clone()))\n        } else {\n            // Cache miss\n            *self.misses.write().await += 1;\n            trace!(\"Cache miss for key {:?}\", key);\n            Ok(None)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Insert a result into the cache.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(())` on success, or `Err` if the cache is disabled.\n    pub async fn insert(&self, key: CacheKey, data: Vec<u8>) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        let ttl = Duration::from_millis(self.config.ttl_ms);\n        let entry = CacheEntry::new(data, ttl);\n\n        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;\n        debug!(\"Cache insert for key {:?} (TTL: {:?})\", key, ttl);\n        cache.put(key, entry);\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Invalidate a specific cache entry.\n    pub async fn invalidate(&self, key: &CacheKey) {\n        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;\n        cache.pop(key);\n        debug!(\"Cache invalidated for key {:?}\", key);\n    }\n\n    /// Clear all entries from the cache.\n    pub async fn clear(&self) {\n        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;\n        cache.clear();\n        debug!(\"Cache cleared\");\n    }\n\n    /// Get the current number of entries in the cache.\n    pub async fn len(&self) -> usize {\n        let cache = self.cache.read().await;\n        cache.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if the cache is empty.\n    pub async fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        let cache = self.cache.read().await;\n        cache.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Get cache statistics (hits, misses, hit rate).\n    pub async fn stats(&self) -> CacheStats {\n        let hits = *self.hits.read().await;\n        let misses = *self.misses.read().await;\n        let total = hits + misses;\n        let hit_rate = if total > 0 {\n            Some(hits as f64 / total as f64)\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        CacheStats {\n            hits,\n            misses,\n            hit_rate,\n            entries: self.len().await,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a cache key from query components.\n    ///\n    /// This is a convenience method for generating cache keys.\n    pub fn make_key(\n        index_name: &str,\n        canonicalized_query_body: &str,\n        settings_version: u64,\n    ) -> CacheKey {\n        CacheKey::new(index_name, canonicalized_query_body, settings_version)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Cache statistics.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct CacheStats {\n    /// Number of cache hits.\n    pub hits: u64,\n    /// Number of cache misses.\n    pub misses: u64,\n    /// Hit rate (0.0 to 1.0), or None if no requests.\n    pub hit_rate: Option<f64>,\n    /// Current number of entries in the cache.\n    pub entries: usize,\n}\n\n/// Clone implementation for ResultCache.\n///\n/// This creates a shallow clone that shares the underlying cache data\n/// and statistics. This is safe because all operations are synchronized\n/// via `Arc<RwLock>`.\nimpl Clone for ResultCache {\n    fn clone(&self) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            cache: self.cache.clone(),\n            config: self.config.clone(),\n            hits: self.hits.clone(),\n            misses: self.misses.clone(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Helper function for canonicalizing query JSON\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Canonicalize a query JSON object for consistent hashing.\n///\n/// This sorts object keys alphabetically to ensure that semantically\n/// identical queries (e.g., `{\"q\":\"a\",\"limit\":10}` vs `{\"limit\":10,\"q\":\"a\"}`)\n/// produce the same cache key.\npub fn canonicalize_query(query: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<String> {\n    match query {\n        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {\n            // Sort keys and recursively canonicalize values\n            let mut sorted_map = serde_json::Map::new();\n            let mut sorted_keys: Vec<&String> = map.keys().collect();\n            sorted_keys.sort();\n\n            for key in sorted_keys {\n                if let Some(value) = map.get(key) {\n                    sorted_map.insert(\n                        key.clone(),\n                        serde_json::from_str(&canonicalize_query(value)?)?\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n\n            Ok(serde_json::to_string(&sorted_map)?)\n        }\n        serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {\n            // Canonicalize array elements\n            let canonicalized: Result<Vec<String>> = arr\n                .iter()\n                .map(|v| canonicalize_query(v))\n                .collect();\n            let canonical_arr: Vec<serde_json::Value> = canonicalized?\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| serde_json::from_str(s).unwrap())\n                .collect();\n            Ok(serde_json::to_string(&canonical_arr)?)\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Primitive values (string, number, bool, null) are already canonical\n            Ok(serde_json::to_string(query)?)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Unit tests\n// .collect();\n519\t\n520\t        let selected = if !healthy_replicas.is_empty() {\n521\t            // Use healthy intra-group replica\n522\t            if let Some(selector) = replica_selector .find_alternate(primary_node, shard_id, *hedge_count)\n1309\t                            .await\n1310\t                        {\n1311\t                            *hedge_count += 1;\n1312\t                            tracing::debug!(\"Hedge sending to {:?}\", alternate_node);\n1313\t\n1314\t                            if let Some(node) = topology.node(&alternate_node) {\n1315\t  /// Injects `showRankingScore: true` unconditionally so the merger can global-sort.\n    /// Each node receives `offset + limit` results to ensure the coordinator has enough\n    /// data to apply pagination.\n    /// Build the request body for sending to a node.\n    ///\n    /// Injects `showRankingScore: true` unconditionally so the merger can global-sort.\n    /// Each node receives `offset + limit` results to ensure the coordinator has enough\n    /// data to apply pagination.\n    ///\n    /// For vector/hybrid queries, applies over-fetch factor (plan §13.12): each shard\n    /// } else {\n            self.offset + self.limit\n        };\n        body[\"limit\"] = serde_json::json!(per_shard_limit);\n\n        // Set offset to 0 on individual nodes (coordinator handles ///\n    /// Returns VectorMode::Hybrid if the request has a `hybrid` field,\n    /// VectorMode::VectorOnly if it has `vector` field but no `q`,\n    /// KeywordOnly otherwise.\n    pub fn      // Check for pure vector search (has vector field, no query)\n        if body.get(\"vector\").is_some() {\n            if body\n                .get(\"q\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                .is_some_and(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            {\n                // Has both vector and query → hybrid\n                return VectorMode::Hybrid;\n            }\n            return VectorMode::VectorOnly;\n        }\n\n        // Check for _vectors (Meilisearch's stored vectors field)\n        if body.get(\"_vectors\").is_some() {\n            if body\n                .get(\"q\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                .is_some_and(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            {\n                return VectorMode::Hybrid;\n            }\n            return VectorMode::VectorOnly;\n        }\n\n        // Pure keyword search\n        VectorMode::KeywordOnly\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct ScatterResult {\n    pub shard_pages: async fn plan_search_scatter(\n    topology: &Topology,\n    query_seq: u64,\n    rf: usize,\n    shard_count: u32,\n    replica_selector: Option<&ReplicaSelector>,\n) -> ScatterPlan {\n    let chosen_group = crate::router::query_group_active(query_seq, topology);\n\n    let group = match topology.group(chosen_group) {\n        Some(g) => g,\n        None => {\n            return ScatterPlan {\n                chosen_group,\n                target_shards: Vec::new(),\n                shard_to_node: HashMap::new(),\n                deadline_ms: 0,\n                hedging_eligible: within the group\n        let healthy_replicas: Vec<NodeId> = replicas\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|node_id| {\n                node_map\n                    .get(node_id)\n Some(node) => node,\n                    None => healthy_replicas[(query_seq as usize) % healthy_replicas.len()].clone(),\n                }\n            } else {\n                healthy_replicas[(query_seq as usize) % healthy_replicas.len()].clone()\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Cross-group fallback: try other groups for this shard\n            let mut fallback_node = None;\n            'fallback: for group_id in 0..topology.replica_group_count() {\n                if group_id == chosen_group {\n                    continue;\n                }\n search scatter using adaptive replica selection (plan §13.3).\n///\n/// Uses EWMA-based scoring to select the best replica for each shard,\n/// falling back to round-robin for shards with no metrics data.\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(query_seq, rf, shard_count))]\npub async fn plan_search_scatter_adaptive(\n    topology: &Topology,\n    query_seq: u64,\n    rf: usize,\n    shard_count: u32,\n    replica_selector: &ReplicaSelector,\n) -> ScatterPlan {\n    let chosen_group = crate::router::query_group_active(query_seq, topology);\n\n    let group = match topology.group(chosen_group) {\n        Some(g) => g,\n        None => {\n            return ScatterPlan {\n                chosen_group,\n                target_shards: Vec::new(),\n                shard_to_node: HashMap::new(),\n                deadline_ms: 0,\n                hedging_eligible: false,\n            };\n        }\n    };\n\n    // If the group has no nodes, return a plan with no targets\n    if group.nodes().is_empty() fields(node_count))]\npub async fn execute_scatter<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    policy: UnavailableShardPolicy,\n) -> Result<ScatterResult> {\n    let mut node_to_shards: HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u32>> = HashMap::new();\n    for (&shard_id, node_id) in &plan.shard_to_node {\n        if plan.target_shards.contains(&shard_id) {\n            node_to_shards\n                .entry(node_id.clone())\n                .or_default()\n                .push(shard_id);\n        }\n    }\n    tracing::Span::current().record(\"node_count\", node_to_shards.len());\n\n    let mut shard_pages = Vec::new();\n    let mut failed_shards = HashMap::new();\n    let mut deadline_exceeded = false;\n\n    let mut tasks = Vec::new();\n    for (node_id, shards) in node_to_shards {\n        let node = match topology.node(&node_id) {\n            Some(n) => n.clone(),\n            None => {\n                for shard_id in shards {\n                    failed_shards.insert(\n                        shard_id,\n                        NodeError::NetworkError(\"node not in topology\".to_string()),\n                    );\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n        let client_ref = client;\n        let req_clone = req.clone();\n        let node_id_clone = node_id.clone();\n        let shard_count = shards.len();\n        // Create a span for this node's scatter call\n        let span = info_span!(\n            \"scatter_node\",\n            node_id = %node_id_clone,\n            address = %node.address,\n            shard_count = shard_count,\n        );\n        tasks.push(\n            async move {\n                let result = client_ref\n                    .search_node(&node_id_clone, &node.address, &req_clone)\n                    .await;\n                (node_id_clone, shards, result)\n            }\n            .instrument(span),\n        );\n    }\n\n    let results = futures_util::future::join_all(tasks).await;\n\n    for (_node_id, shards, result) in results {\n        match result {\n            Ok(body) => {\n                for _shard_id in shards {\n                    shard_pages.push(ShardHitPage { body: body.clone() });\n                }\n            }\n            Err(NodeError::Timeout) => {\n                deadline_exceeded = true;\n                for shard_id in shards {\n                    failed_shards.insert(shard_id, NodeError::Timeout);\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                for shard_id in shards {\n                    failed_shards.insert(shard_id, e.clone());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let partial = !failed_shards.is_empty();\n\n    match policy {\n        UnavailableShardPolicy::Error => {\n            if !failed_shards.is_empty() {\n                return Err(crate::error::MiroirError::Routing(format!(\n                    \"{} shard(s) unavailable\",\n                    failed_shards.len()\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        UnavailableShardPolicy::Partial => {}\n        UnavailableShardPolicy::Fallback => {\n            // Group-unavailability fallback: try other replica groups for failed shards\n            if !failed_shards.is_empty() {\n                let mut fallback_pages = Vec::new();\n                let mut remaining_failed = HashMap::new();\n\n                for (&shard_id, error) in &failed_shards {\n                    let mut fallback_succeeded = false;\n\n                    // Try each other replica group\n                    for group_id in 0..topology.replica_group_count() {\n                        if group_id == plan.chosen_group {\n                            continue; // Skip the already-tried group\n                        }\n\n                        if let Some(group) = topology.group(group_id) {\n                            let replicas = crate::router::assign_shard_in_group(\n                                shard_id,\n                                group.nodes(),\n                                topology.rf(),\n                            );\n                            if replicas.is_empty() {\n                                continue;\n                            }\n\n                            // Try each replica in the fallback group\n                            for node_id in replicas {\n                                if let Some(node) = topology.node(&node_id) {\n                                    match client.search_node(&node_id, &node.address, &req).await {\n                                        Ok(body) => {\n                                            fallback_pages.push(ShardHitPage { body });\n                                            fallback_succeeded = true;\n                                            break;\n                                        }\n                                        Err(_) => {\n                                            continue; // Try next replica\n                                        }\n                                    }\n                                }\n                            }\n\n                            if fallback_succeeded {\n                                break; // Found a working replica\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n\n                    if !fallback_succeeded {\n                        remaining_failed.insert(shard_id, error.clone());\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // Merge fallback results\n                shard_pages.extend(fallback_pages);\n\n                // Update failed_shards with only those that truly failed\n                if remaining_failed.is_empty() {\n                    // All shards succeeded via fallback\n                    return Ok(ScatterResult {\n                        shard_pages,\n                        failed_shards: HashMap::new(),\n                        partial: false,\n                        deadline_exceeded,\n                    });\n                } else {\n                    // Some shards still failed\n                    failed_shards = remaining_failed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(ScatterResult {\n        shard_pages,\n        failed_shards,\n        partial,\n        deadline_exceeded,\n    })\n}\n\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(index = %req.index_uid))]\npub async fn scatter_gather_search<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    policy: UnavailableShardPolicy,\n    strategy: &dyn MergeStrategy,\n) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let scatter_result = execute_scatter(plan, client, req.clone(), topology, policy).await?;\n\n    let mut shard_pages = scatter_result.shard_pages;\n    if scatter_result.partial {\n        for shard_id in scatter_result.failed_shards.keys() {\n            shard_pages.push(ShardHitPage {\n                body: serde_json::json!({\"success\": false, \"message\": format!(\"shard {} unavailable\", shard_id)}),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Collect failed shard IDs for the X-Miroir-Degraded header\n    let failed_shards: Vec<u32> = scatter_result.failed_shards.keys().copied().collect();\n\n    let merge_input = MergeInput {\n        shard_hits: shard_pages,\n        offset: req.offset,\n        limit: req.limit,\n        client_requested_score: req.ranking_score,\n        facets: req.facets.clone(),\n        failed_shards,\n        vector_mode: req.vector_mode,\n        vector_config: req.vector_config.clone(),\n    };\n\n    // Span for the merge operation\n    let _span = info_span!(\n        \"merge\",\n        shard_count = merge_input.shard_hits.len(),\n        offset = req.offset,\n        limit = req.limit,\n    )\n    .entered();\n\n    strategy.merge(merge_input)\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// OP#4: Global-IDF preflight execution\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Extract unique query terms from a search query string.\npub fn extract_query_terms(query: &Option<String>) -> Vec<String> {\n    match query {\n        Some(q) if !q.is_empty() => {\n            let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n            let mut terms = Vec::new();\n            for term in q.split_whitespace() {\n                let lower = term.to_lowercase();\n                if seen.insert(lower.clone()) {\n                    terms.push(lower);\n                }\n            }\n            terms\n        }\n        _ => Vec::new(),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Execute the preflight phase: gather term frequencies from all shards.\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(node_count, term_count = req.terms.len()))]\npub async fn execute_preflight<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: &ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: &PreflightRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n) -> Result<GlobalIdf> {\n    if req.terms.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(GlobalIdf {\n            total_docs: 0,\n            avg_doc_length: 0.0,\n            terms: HashMap::new(),\n        });\n    }\n\n    let mut node_to_shards: HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u32>> = HashMap::new();\n    for (&shard_id, node_id) in &plan.shard_to_node {\n        if plan.target_shards.contains(&shard_id) {\n            node_to_shards\n                .entry(node_id.clone())\n                .or_default()\n                .push(shard_id);\n        }\n    }\n\n    let mut tasks = Vec::new();\n    for (node_id, _) in node_to_shards {\n        let node = match topology.node(&node_id) {\n            Some(n) => n.clone(),\n            None => continue,\n        };\n        let client_ref = client;\n        let req_clone = req.clone();\n        let nid = node_id.clone();\n        tasks.push(async move {\n            client_ref\n                .preflight_node(&nid, &node.address, &req_clone)\n                .await\n        });\n    }\n\n    let results = futures_util::future::join_all(tasks).await;\n    let responses: Vec<PreflightResponse> = results.into_iter().filter_map(|r| r.ok()).collect();\n    Ok(GlobalIdf::from_preflight_responses(&responses))\n}\n\n/// Execute a full dfs_query_then_fetch search (OP#4 global-IDF preflight).\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(index = %req.index_uid))]\npub async fn dfs_query_then_fetch_search<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    policy: UnavailableShardPolicy,\n    strategy: &dyn MergeStrategy,\n) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let preflight_req = PreflightRequest {\n        index_uid: req.index_uid.clone(),\n        terms: extract_query_terms(&req.query),\n        filter: req.filter.clone(),\n    };\n    let global_idf = execute_preflight(&plan, client, &preflight_req, topology).await?;\n    let mut search_req = req;\n    search_req.global_idf = Some(global_idf);\n    scatter_gather_search(plan, client, search_req, topology, policy, strategy).await\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// §13.2 Hedged requests for tail-latency mitigation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Execute a single node request with hedging support.\n///\n/// If hedging is enabled and the primary request exceeds the p95 deadline,\n/// a duplicate request is sent to an alternate replica. The first response wins.\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(node_id = %primary_node, shard_id))]\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\npub async fn execute_hedged_request<C: NodeClient>(\n    client: &C,\n    primary_node: &NodeId,\n    primary_address: &str,\n    shard_id: u32,\n    req: &SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    hedging_manager: Option<&HedgingManager>,\n    hedge_count: &mut u32,\n) -> (\n    std::result::Result<Value, NodeError>,\n    Option<HedgeOutcome>,\n    Duration,\n) {\n    let start = Instant::now();\n\n    // Check if hedging is enabled and we haven't exceeded the budget\n    let hedge_deadline = if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n        if *hedge_count < manager.config().max_hedges_per_query {\n            let deadline = manager.hedge_deadline(primary_node).await;\n            tracing::debug!(\"Hedge deadline for {:?}: {:?}\", primary_node, deadline);\n            deadline\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                \"Hedge budget exhausted: {} >= {}\",\n                *hedge_count,\n                manager.config().max_hedges_per_query\n            );\n            None\n        }\n    } else {\n        tracing::debug!(\"Hedging disabled (no manager)\");\n        None\n    };\n\n    match hedge_deadline {\n        Some(deadline) => {\n            // Hedging enabled: try primary with timeout, then hedge\n            //\n            // The key insight: we want to cancel the primary if it's too slow\n            // and the hedge completes successfully. We use tokio::select! with\n            // a timeout to achieve this.\n\n            // First, try the primary with a timeout equal to the hedge deadline\n            let primary_result = tokio::time::timeout(\n                deadline,\n                client.search_node(primary_node, primary_address, req),\n            )\n            .await;\n\n            match primary_result {\n                Ok(Ok(value)) => {\n                    // Primary completed within deadline - no hedge needed\n                    let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n                    tracing::debug!(\"Primary completed within deadline {:?}\", elapsed);\n\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                        manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n                    }\n\n                    (Ok(value), None, elapsed)\n                }\n                Ok(Err(err)) => {\n                    // Primary failed within deadline - return error\n                    let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n                    tracing::debug!(\"Primary failed within deadline {:?}\", elapsed);\n\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                        manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n                    }\n\n                    (Err(err), None, elapsed)\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    // Primary timed out - try hedge\n                    tracing::debug!(\"Primary timed out after {:?}, trying hedge\", deadline);\n\n                    // Find an alternate replica\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        if let Some(alternate_node) = manager\n                            .find_alternate(primary_node, shard_id, *hedge_count)\n                            .await\n                        {\n                            *hedge_count += 1;\n                            tracing::debug!(\"Hedge sending to {:?}\", alternate_node);\n\n                            if let Some(node) = topology.node(&alternate_node) {\n                                let hedge_start = Instant::now();\n                                let hedge_result = client\n                                    .search_node(&alternate_node, &node.address, req)\n                                    .await;\n                                let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n\n                                // Record latency for primary (it timed out)\n                                manager\n                                    .record_latency(primary_node, deadline.as_millis() as f64)\n                                    .await;\n\n                                match &hedge_result {\n                                    Ok(_) => {\n                                        tracing::debug!(\n                                            \"Hedge to {:?} succeeded in {:?}\",\n                                            alternate_node,\n                                            hedge_start.elapsed()\n                                        );\n                                    }\n                                    Err(e) => {\n                                        tracing::debug!(\n                                            \"Hedge to {:?} failed: {:?}\",\n                                            alternate_node,\n                                            e\n                                        );\n                                    }\n                                }\n\n                                return (hedge_result, Some(HedgeOutcome::HedgeWon), elapsed);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n\n                    // No alternate available - wait for primary to complete\n                    tracing::debug!(\"No alternate available, waiting for primary\");\n                    let primary_result =\n                        client.search_node(primary_node, primary_address, req).await;\n                    let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                        manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n                    }\n\n                    (primary_result, Some(HedgeOutcome::PrimaryWon), elapsed)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        None => {\n            // No hedging - execute primary request only\n            let result = client.search_node(primary_node, primary_address, req).await;\n            let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n\n            // Record latency observation\n            if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n            }\n\n            (result, None, elapsed)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Mock client\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct MockNodeClient {\n    pub responses: HashMap<NodeId, Value>,\n    pub preflight_responses: HashMap<NodeId, PreflightResponse>,\n    pub write_responses: HashMap<NodeId, WriteResponse>,\n    pub fetch_responses: HashMap<NodeId, FetchDocumentsResponse>,\n    pub errors: HashMap<NodeId, NodeError>,\n    pub delay_ms: u64,\n}\n\nimpl NodeClient for MockNodeClient {\n    async fn search_node(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        _request: &SearchRequest,\n    ) -> std::result::Result<Value, NodeError> {\n        if self.delay_ms > 0 {\n            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(self.delay_ms)).await;\n        }\n        if let Some(err) = self.errors.get(node) {\n            return Err(err.clone());\n        }\n        Ok(self.responses.get(node).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            serde_json::json!({\"hits\": [], \"estimatedTotalHits\": 0, \"processingTimeMs\": 0, \"facetDistribution\": {}})\n        }))\n    }\n\n    async fn preflight_node(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        _request: &PreflightRequest,\n    ) -> std::result::Result<PreflightResponse, NodeError> {\n        if let Some(err) = self.errors.get(node) {\n            return Err(err.clone());\n        }\n        Ok(self\n            .preflight_responses\n            .get(node)\n            .cloned()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 1000,\n                avg_doc_length: 50.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::new(),\n            }))\n    }\n\n    async fn write_documents(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        _request: &WriteRequest,\n    ) -> std::result::Result<WriteResponse, NodeError> {\n        if let Some(err) = self.errors.get(node) {\n            return Err(err.clone());\n        }\n        Ok(self\n            .write_responses\n            .get(node)\n            .cloned()\n            .unwrap_or(WriteResponse {\n                success: true,\n                task_uid: Some(1),\n                message: None,\n                code: None,\n                error_type: None,\n            }))\n    }\n\n    async fn delete_documents(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        _request: &DeleteByIdsRequest,\n    ) -> std::result::Result<DeleteResponse, NodeError> {\n        if let Some(err) = self.errors.get(node) {\n            return Err(err.clone());\n        }\n        Ok(DeleteResponse {\n            success: true,\n            task_uid: Some(1),\n            message: None,\n            code: None,\n            error_type: None,\n        })\n    }\n\n    async fn delete_documents_by_filter(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        _request: &DeleteByFilterRequest,\n    ) -> std::result::Result<DeleteResponse, NodeError> {\n        if let Some(err) = self.errors.get(node) {\n            return Err(err.clone());\n        }\n        Ok(DeleteResponse {\n            success: true,\n            task_uid: Some(1),\n            message: None,\n            code: None,\n            error_type: None,\n        })\n    }\n\n    async fn fetch_documents(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        request: &FetchDocumentsRequest,\n    ) -> std::result::Result<FetchDocumentsResponse, NodeError> {\n        if let Some(err) = self.errors.get(node) {\n            return Err(err.clone());\n        }\n        // Return stored fetch response if available, otherwise return empty\n        let stored =\n            self.fetch_responses\n                .get(node)\n                .cloned()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| FetchDocumentsResponse {\n                    results: Vec::new(),\n                    limit: request.limit,\n                    offset: request.offset,\n                    total: 0,\n                });\n\n        // Handle pagination: if offset exceeds total, return empty results\n        if request.offset as u64 >= stored.total {\n            return Ok(FetchDocumentsResponse {\n                results: Vec::new(),\n                limit: request.limit,\n                offset: request.offset,\n                total: stored.total,\n            });\n        }\n\n        Ok(stored)\n    }\n\n    fn get_task_status(\n        &self,\n        node: &NodeId,\n        _address: &str,\n        _request: &TaskStatusRequest,\n    ) -> impl std::future::Future<Output = std::result::Result<TaskStatusResponse, NodeError>> + Send\n    {\n        let node = node.clone();\n        let task_uid = _request.task_uid;\n        let error = self.errors.get(&node).cloned();\n        async move {\n            if let Some(err) = error {\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n            Ok(TaskStatusResponse {\n                task_uid,\n                status: \"succeeded\".to_string(),\n                error: None,\n                error_type: None,\n            })\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::topology::{Node, NodeId};\n    use std::sync::Arc;\n\n    fn make_test_topology() -> Topology {\n        let mut async fn test_dfs_query_then_fetch() {\n        let topo = make_test_topology();\n        let plan = plan_search_scatter(&topo, 0, 2, 64, None).await;\n        let mut c = MockNodeClient::default();\n        c.responses.insert(NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()), serde_json::json!({\"hits\": [{\"id\": \"a\", \"_rankingScore\": 0.9}], \"estimatedTotalHits\": 1, \"processingTimeMs\": 5}));\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 50000,\n                avg_doc_length: 50.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([(\"test\".into(), TermStats { df: 500 })]),\n            },\n        );\n        let s = crate::merger::RrfStrategy::default_strategy();\n        let r = dfs_query_then_fetch_search(\n            plan,\n            &c,\n            make_req(),\n            &topo,\n            UnavailableShardPolicy::Partial,\n            &s,\n        )\n        .await\n        .unwrap();\n        assert!(!r.degraded);\n        assert!(!r.hits.is_empty());\n    }\n\n    /// Integration test for dfs_query_then_fetch with severely skewed shard distribution.\n    ///\n    /// This test simulates the scenario described in miroir-yio:\n    /// - Shard 0: Normal (1,000 docs, term df = 100)\n    /// - Shard 1: 100x normal (100,000 docs, term df = 10,000)\n    /// - Shard 2: Near-empty (10 docs, term df = 1)\n    ///\n    /// Without global IDF preflight, each shard would compute different local IDF values:\n    /// - Shard 0: IDF ≈ log((1000 - 100 + 0.5) / (100 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n    /// - Shard 1: IDF ≈ log((100000 - 10000 + 0.5) / (10000 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n    /// - Shard 2: IDF ≈ log((10 - 1 + 0.5) / (1 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.8\n    ///\n    /// With global IDF preflight, all shards use the same IDF:\n    /// - Global: N = 101,010, df = 10,101\n    /// - IDF ≈ log((101010 - 10101 + 0.5) / (10101 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n    ///\n    /// This ensures scores are comparable across shards, enabling correct score-based merge.\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn test_dfs_skewed_shards_global_idf_aggregation() {\n        let mut topo = Topology::new(3, 1, 1);\n        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n            \"http://node-0:7700\".into(),\n            0,\n        ));\n        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-1\".into()),\n            \"http://node-1:7700\".into(),\n            0,\n        ));\n        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-2\".into()),\n            \"http://node-2:7700\".into(),\n            0,\n        ));\n\n        let plan = plan_search_scatter(&topo, 0, 1, 3, None).await;\n\n        // Simulate severely skewed shard distribution\n        let mut c = MockNodeClient::default();\n\n        // Shard 0: Normal distribution\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 1000,\n                avg_doc_length: 50.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 100 }),\n                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 80 }),\n                ]),\n            },\n        );\n\n        // Shard 1: 100x normal (severely skewed)\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-1\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 100_000,\n                avg_doc_length: 55.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 10_000 }),\n                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 8_000 }),\n                ]),\n            },\n        );\n\n        // Shard 2: Near-empty\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-2\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 10,\n                avg_doc_length: 45.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 1 }),\n                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 1 }),\n                ]),\n            },\n        );\n\n        // Execute preflight to get global IDF\n        let preflight_req = PreflightRequest {\n            index_uid: \"test\".into(),\n            terms: vec![\"machine\".into(), \"learning\".into()],\n            filter: None,\n        };\n\n        let global_idf = execute_preflight(&plan, &c, &preflight_req, &topo)\n            .await\n            .unwrap();\n\n        // Verify global aggregation\n        assert_eq!(global_idf.total_docs, 101_010);\n        assert_eq!(global_idf.terms.get(\"machine\").unwrap().df, 10_101);\n        assert_eq!(global_idf.terms.get(\"learning\").unwrap().df, 8_081);\n\n        // Verify global IDF is the same for all shards\n        // Expected IDF for \"machine\": log((101010 - 10101 + 0.5) / (10101 + 0.5)) + 1\n        let expected_idf_machine: f64 =\n            ((101010.0_f64 - 10101.0 + 0.5) / (10101.0 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0;\n        let actual_idf_machine = global_idf.terms.get(\"machine\").unwrap().idf;\n        assert!((actual_idf_machine - expected_idf_machine).abs() < 0.001);\n\n        // Expected IDF for \"learning\": log((101010 - 8081 + 0.5) / tenant_pinned_group\n    };\n\n    // Query coalescing (plan §13.10): Check for identical in-flight queries\n    // Skip for multi-target aliases (each target is different)\n    if }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Result cache lookup (plan §13.10): Check for cached completed results\n    // Skip for multi-target aliases (each target is different)\n    if {\n                                response = response.header(\"X-Miroir-Settings-Inconsistent\", \"true\");\n                            }\n                            if settings_version > 0 {\n {\n                                response = response.header(\"X-Miroir-Settings-Inconsistent\", \"true\");\n                            }\n                            if settings_version > 0 {\n §13.4): narrow target shards based on PK constraints\n    let filter_string = filter.as_ref().and_then(|v| {\n        // Convert filter Value to string representation for QueryPlanner\n        if v.is_string() {\n            v.as_str().map(|s| s.to_string())\n        } else {\n            // For object/array filters, serialize to JSON string\n            serde_json::to_string(v).ok()\n {\n        Some(query_plan.target_shards)\n    } else {\n        None\n    };\n\n    let policy = match state.config.scatter.unavailable_shard_policy.as_str() {\n        \"partial\" => UnavailableShardPolicy::Partial,\n        \"error\" => UnavailableShardPolicy::Error,\n        \"fallback\" => UnavailableShardPolicy::Fallback,\n        _ => {\n            return Response::builder()\n                .status(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)\n                .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                .unwrap()\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Plan scatter \"adaptive\";\n        let replica_selector_ref = if use_adaptive {\n            Some(state.replica_selector.as_ref())\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        // Session pinning or tenant affinity: if effective_pinned_group is set, use group-specific planning\n        if let Some(group) = effective_pinned_group {\n            let _plan_span = tracing::info_span!(\n min_settings_version,\n                pinned_group = ?effective_pinned_group,\n                tenant_id = ?tenant_id,\n                strategy = %state.config.replica_selection.strategy,\n state.config.shards,\n                        replica_selector_ref,\n                        narrowed_shards,\n                    )\n                    .await\n                }\n            }\n 0,\n                state.config.replication_factor as usize,\n                state.config.shards,\n                &index,\n                floor,\n                &move |idx, node_id| {\n                    // Use a blocking task wrapper since we're in a sync context\n                    let sb = settings_broadcast.clone();\n                    let idx = idx.to_string();\n                    let sb.node_version(&idx, &node_id).await })\n                    })\n                },\n                replica_selector_ref,\n            )\n            .await;\n\n            match plan_result {\n                Some(p) => p,\n                None => {\n                    // No covering set could be assembled after filtering by version floor\n                    let _err = MeilisearchError::new(\n                        MiroirCode::SettingsVersionStale,\n                        format!(\n                            \"no covering set available for settings version floor {floor} on index '{index}'\"\n                        ),\n                    );\n                    return Response::builder()\n                        .status(StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)\n                        .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                        .unwrap();\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // No version floor requested, use normal planning with query planner narrowing\n            plan_search_scatter_with_narrowing(\n                &topo,\n                0,\n                state.config.replication_factor as usize,\n                state.config.shards,\n                replica_selector_ref,\n                narrowed_shards,\n            )\n            .await\n        }\n    };\n    let node_count = plan.shard_to_node.len() as u64;\n\n    // Record scatter fan-out size before executing\n    state.metrics.record_scatter_fan_out(node_count);\n\n    // Build search request\n    // Clone facets for fingerprinting and cache storage before moving into SearchRequest\n    let facets_clone = body.facets.clone();\n    let facets_for_cache = body.facets.clone(); // Additional clone for cache storage\n    let rest_body = body.rest.clone(); // Clone before body is partially moved\n\n    // Detect vector search mode from request body (plan §13.12)\n    let vector_mode = SearchRequest::detect_vector_mode(&rest_body);\n\n    // Apply over-fetch factor for vector/hybrid queries (plan §13.12)\n    let effective_over_fetch = if vector_mode != VectorMode::KeywordOnly {\n        // Record over-fetch metric (plan §13.12)\n        state.metrics.inc_vector_search_over_fetched();\n        // Record merge strategy metric\n        state\n            .metrics\n            .inc_vector_merge_strategy(&state.config.vector_search.merge_strategy);\n        over_fetch_factor\n    } else {\n        1 // No over-fetch for pure keyword queries\n    };\n\n    // Capture query data for canary creation before search_req is moved (plan §13.18)\n    let capture_query = body.q.clone().unwrap_or_default();\n    let capture_body = rest_body.clone();\n    let offset: body.offset.unwrap_or(0),\n        limit: body.limit.unwrap_or(20),\n        filter,\n        facets: body.facets,\n        ranking_score: client_requested_score,\n        body: rest_body,\n ));\n    let client = ProxyNodeClient::new(http_client, state.metrics.clone(), None);\n\n    // Use score-based merge strategy (OP#4: requires global IDF)\n    let strategy = is enabled and this is a single-target query\n    let (tx, fingerprint) = if state.config.query_coalescing.enabled && resolved_targets.len() == 1\n    {\n        let settings_version = state.settings_broadcast.current_version().await;\n        // Reconstruct body for fingerprinting (use cloned facets)\n        let fingerprint_body = SearchRequestBody {\n            q:            ranking_score: Some(search_req.ranking_score),\n            rest: search_req.body.clone(),\n        };\n        let query_json = serde_json::to_string(&fingerprint_body).unwrap_or_default();\n        let fp = QueryFingerprint {\n            index: effective_index.clone(),\n            query_json,\n            settings_version,\n        };\n\n        match state.query_coalescer.register(fp.clone()).await {\n            Ok(broadcast_tx) => {\n                state.metrics.inc_query_coalesce_subscribers(1); // First subscriber = the query itself\n                (Some(broadcast_tx), Some(fp))\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Failed to register (too many pending queries) - proceed without coalescing\n                debug!(\"too many pending queries, proceeding without coalescing registration\");\n                (None, None)\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        (None, None)\n    };\n\n    // Execute DFS query-then-fetch\n    let mut result = match dfs_query_then_fetch_search(\n        plan, &client, search_req, &topo, policy, &strategy,\n    )\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %e, \"search failed\");\n            return Response::builder()\n                .status(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)\n                .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                .unwrap();\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Drop topology lock before building response\n    drop(topo);\n\n    // Strip internal fields from hits\n    for hit in &mut result.hits {\n        strip_internal_fields(hit, client_requested_score);\n    }\n\n    // Build response body\n    let    // Only include facetDistribution if facets were requested\n    let mut body = response_body.clone();\n    if let Some(facets) = &result.facet_distribution {\n        body[\"facetDistribution\"] = serde_json::to_value(facets).unwrap_or(Value::Null);\n    }\n\n    // Store result in cache (plan §13.10): Cache successful scatter-gather results\n    // Only cache single-target queries (multi-target aliases have different results per target)\n    if state.config.result_cache.enabled && resolved_targets.len() == 1 {\n        // Get settings version for cache key\n        let                &canonicalized_query,\n                settings_version,\n            );\n\n            // Serialize the response body for caching\n            if let Ok(response_bytes) =      index = %effective_index,\n                            \"result cached successfully\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        debug!(error = %e, \"failed to store result in cache\");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Capture query for canary creation if a capture session is active (plan §13.18)\n    // This captures production queries + responses to create golden pairs for canary testing\n    let search_params: std::collections::HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> =\n        serde_json::from_value(capture_body).unwrap_or_default();\n    state\n        .query_capture\n        .capture(\n            effective_index.clone(),\n            miroir_core::canary::SearchQuery serde_json::from_value(h.clone()).unwrap_or_default();\n                        miroir_core::canary::Hit { fields }\n                    })\n                    .collect(),\n                estimated_total_hits: result.estimated_total_hits as usize,\n                processing_time_ms: result.processing_time_ms as usize,\n                query: capture_query,\n            },\n        )\n serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();\n        let subscriber_count = broadcast_tx.receiver_count();\n        if subscriber_count > 1 {\n            // There are other queries waiting for this result - broadcast to them\n            state\n                .metrics\n                .inc_query_coalesce_subscribers(subscriber_count as u64 - 1);\n            let _ = broadcast_tx.send(response_bytes.clone());\n            debug!(\n                index = %effective_index,\n                subscribers = subscriber_count - 1,\n                \"broadcast search result to coalesced queries\"\n            );\n        }\n        // Unregister the query after broadcasting\n        state.query_coalescer.unregister(&fp).await;\n    }\n\n    // Build response with optional headers\n    let mut response = Response::builder()\n        .status(StatusCode::OK)\n        .header(\"content-type\", \"application/json\");\n\n    // Add X-Miroir-Settings-Inconsistent header if a broadcast is in flight (plan §13.5)\n    if state\n        .settings_broadcast\n        .is_in_flight(&effective_index)\n        .await\n    {\n        response = state.settings_broadcast.current_version().await;\n    if current_version > 0 {\n        response = response.header(\"X-Miroir-Settings-Version\", current_version.to_string());\n    }\n\n    if       .join(\",\");\n        response = response.header(\"X-Miroir-Degraded\", format!(\"shards={shard_ids}\"));\n    } else if result.degraded {\n        response =   .unwrap();\n\n    // Shadow the request to configured targets (plan §13.16)\n    // This is done asynchronously after returning the primary response\n    if let Some(ref shadow_manager) = state.shadow_manager {\n        // Clone data needed for the async task\n        let shadow_mgr = shadow_manager.clone();\n        let index_clone = effective_index.clone();\n        let request_body = serde_json::to_value(&body).unwrap_or_default();\n        let primary_hits = result.hits.clone();\n        let primary_latency = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n        let config =          continue;\n                }\n\n                // Convert target to shadow target\n                let shadow_target = miroir_core::shadow::ShadowTarget {\n                    name:                        _ => None,\n                        })\n                        .collect(),\n                };\n\n                // Check if this request should be shadowed\n                if !shadow_mgr.should_shadow(&shadow_target) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                // Shadow the request\n                let result = shadow_mgr\n                    .shadow_search(\n                        &shadow_target,\n                        &index_clone,\n                        &request_body,\n                        primary_latency,\n                        &primary_hits,\n                    )\n                    .await;\n\n                match result {\n                    Ok(_) => {\n                        tracing::debug!(target = shadow_target.name, \"shadow request completed\");\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            target = shadow_target.name,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"shadow request failed\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Structured log entry (plan §10 shape)\n    // request_id and pod_id are included from the middleware span via\n    // .with_current_span(true) on the JSON subscriber layer.\n    tracing::info!(\n        target: \"miroir.search\",\n        index = %effective_index,\n        duration_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,\n        node_count = node_count,\n        estimated_hits = result.estimated_total_hits,\n        degraded = result.degraded,\n        \"search completed\"\n    );\n\n    response\n}\n\n/// Search multiple target indexes (for multi-target aliases, plan §13.7, §13.11, §13.17).\n///\n/// Fans out the search to all target indexes and merges results by _rankingScore.\n/// Used by ILM read_alias queries.\nasync fn search_multi_targets(\n    targets: Vec<String>,\n    body: SearchRequestBody,\n    Extension(state): Extension<Arc<AppState>>,\n    session_id: Option<String>,\n    client_requested_score: bool,\n    min_settings_version: Option<u64>,\n) -> Response<Body> {\n    let start = Instant::now();\n\n    // TODO: Extract source IP from headers\n    let source_ip = \"unknown\".to_string();\n\n    // Check rate limit for search UI (plan §4)\n    let (limit, window_seconds) = match parse_rate_limit(&state.config.search_ui.rate_limit.per_ip)\n    {\n        Ok(parsed) => parsed,\n        Err(e) => {\n            warn!(error = %e, \"invalid search_ui.rate_limit.per_ip config, using default\");\n            (60, 60) // Default: 60 requests per minute\n        }\n    };\n\n    let backend = state.config.search_ui.rate_limit.backend.as_str();\n    if backend == \"redis\" {\n        if let Some(ref redis) = state.redis_store {\n            match redis.check_rate_limit_search_ui(&source_ip, limit, window_seconds) {\n                Ok((allowed, _wait_seconds)) => {\n                    if !allowed {\n                        warn!(\n                            source_ip_hash = hash_for_log(&source_ip),\n                            \"search UI rate limited (redis)\"\n                        );\n                        return Response::builder()\n                            .status(StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS)\n                            .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                            .unwrap();\n                    }\n                    // Allowed, proceed\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    warn!(error = %e, \"failed to check search UI rate limit\");\n                    // Continue anyway on error (fail-open)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    } else if backend == \"local\" {\n        let (allowed, _wait_seconds) =\n            state\n                .local_search_ui_rate_limiter\n                .check(&source_ip, limit, window_seconds * 1000);\n        if !allowed {\n            warn!(\n                source_ip_hash = hash_for_log(&source_ip),\n                \"search UI rate limited (local backend)\"\n            );\n            return Response::builder()\n                .status(StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS)\n                .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                .unwrap();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Session pinning logic (plan §13.6): Check if session has pending write\n    let (pinned_group, _strategy_label) = if let Some(sid) = session_id {\n        if let Some(group) = state.session_manager.get_pinned_group(sid.as_str()).await {\n            // Session has a pending write - apply wait strategy\n            let strategy = state.session_manager.wait_strategy();\n            match strategy {\n                WaitStrategy::Block => {\n                    // Block until write completes or timeout\n                    let max_wait = state.session_manager.max_wait_duration();\n                    let wait_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n                    match state\n                        .session_manager\n                        .wait_for_write_completion(sid.as_str(), &state.task_registry, max_wait)\n                        .await\n                    {\n                        Ok(true) => {\n                            // Write succeeded, clear pin and use normal routing\n                            let wait_duration = wait_start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();\n                            state.metrics.observe_session_wait_duration(wait_duration);\n                            state.metrics.inc_session_pin_enforced(\"block\");\n                            (None::<u32>, None::<u64>)\n                        }\n                        Ok(false) => {\n                            // Write failed, clear pin\n                            let wait_duration = wait_start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();\n                            state.metrics.observe_session_wait_duration(wait_duration);\n                            state.metrics.inc_session_wait_timeout(\"block\");\n                            (None::<u32>, None::<u64>)\n                        }\n                        Err(_) => {\n                            // Timeout - route to pinned group (best effort)\n                            let wait_duration = wait_start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();\n                            state.metrics.observe_session_wait_duration(wait_duration);\n                            state.metrics.inc_session_wait_timeout(\"block\");\n                            (Some(group), None::<u64>)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                WaitStrategy::RoutePin => {\n                    // Route to pinned group without waiting\n                    state.metrics.inc_session_pin_enforced(\"route_pin\");\n                    (Some(group), None::<u64>)\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // No pending write - normal routing\n            (None::<u32>, None::<u64>)\n        }\n    } else {\n        // No session header - normal routing\n        (None::<u32>, None::<u64>)\n    };\n\n    // For multi-target aliases, we use the first target for settings/scoped key\n    // All targets should have compatible settings (managed by ILM)\n    let primary_target = match targets.first() {\n        Some(t) => t,\n        None => {\n            error!(\"multi-target alias has no targets\");\n            return Response::builder()\n                .status(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)\n                .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                .unwrap();\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Get the scoped key for the primary target\n    let search_key = if let Some(ref redis) = state.redis_store {\n        if let Ok(Some(sk)) = redis.get_search_ui_scoped_key(primary_target) {\n            // Refresh scoped-key beacon\n            let _ =\n                redis.observe_search_ui_scoped_key(&state.pod_id, primary_target, sk.generation);\n            sk.primary_key\n        } else {\n            state.config.node_master_key.clone()\n        }\n    } else {\n        state.config.node_master_key.clone()\n    };\n\n    // Use live topology from shared state\n    let topo = state.topology.read().await;\n    let policy = match state.config.scatter.unavailable_shard_policy.as_str() {\n        \"partial\" => UnavailableShardPolicy::Partial,\n        \"error\" => UnavailableShardPolicy::Error,\n        \"fallback\" => UnavailableShardPolicy::Fallback,\n        _ => {\n            return Response::builder()\n                .status(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)\n                .body(axum::body::Body::empty())\n                .unwrap()\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Plan scatter for primary target (for ILM read aliases, all targets\n    // should have identical shard layout)\n    let plan = {\n        let _plan_span = tracing::info_span!(\n            \"scatter_plan_multi_target\",\n            primary_target = %primary_target,\n            replica_groups = state.config.replica_groups,\n            shards = state.config.shards,\n            rf = state.config.replication_factor,\n            min_settings_version,\n            pinned_group = ?pinned_group,\n            target_count = targets.len(),\n        )\n        .entered();\n        drop(_plan_span); // Drop span before await\n\n        if let Some(group) = pinned_group {\n            match plan_search_scatter_for_group(\n                &topo,\n                0,\n                state.config.replication_factor as usize,\n                state.config.shards,\n                group,\n                None,\n            )\n            .await\n            {\n                Some(p) => p,\n                None => {\n                    warn!(\n                        pinned_group = group,\n                        \"pinned group unavailable, falling back to normal routing\"\n                    );\n                    plan_search_scatter(\n                        &topo,\n                        0,\n                        state.config.replication_factor as usize,\n                        state.config.shards,\n                        None,\n
